item.title: Delhi Riots bail hearing: Why the accused persons’ liberty arguments may not overcome UAPA’s strict prima facie bar and how Delhi Police’s conspiracy case still holds in law
item.description: Dave's insistence that Imam is not charged in any FIR involving actual violence ignores a fundamental tenet of conspiracy law, which is that conspiratorial responsibility does not require physical presence at the crime site. Even if someone is far away when the clear crimes are carried out, they might still be a part of a terrorist plot.
